value.page_subtitle: Find your nearest Swift Pharmacy outlet for quality healthcare services, 24/7.
value.network_paragraph: Swift Pharmacy is known as the region's leading pharmacy retail chain. Recognised as the leading pharmacy for customer care and quality healthcare — our neighbourhood pharmacies are easily accessible.
value.outlets_heading: Supportive Personal Care In A Comfortable Environment
value.outlets_paragraph: With a growing network of over 200 pharmacies, we are committed to bringing reliable & quality healthcare closer to our consumers with a pharmacy in every neighbourhood & the services of a knowledgeable pharmacist available 24/7 for every household.
